This file exists so that `npx shadcn@latest add <name>` lands a component in the right place with the right aliases IF one is ever needed - it is not a declaration that shadcn is in use. Every component added later MUST be named and justified in REBUILD_STATUS_v1_00.md under D-2 before it is added.
_INVARIANT: components/ui/ contains only files a section provably needs, each with a written justification in the ledger.
_IMPOSSIBLE: The 37-dead-ui-file class cannot be recreated in one step: there is no bulk install path here and no component is pre-seeded, so dead files can only arrive one deliberate, individually-justified command at a time.

A CI grep counting components/ui/* against the ledger's D-2 list would close that gap; it does not exist. This file also names app/globals.css and lib/utils, neither of which this delegate created - both belong to other delegates.
